meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: Claude 会按代码结构（AST）而不是字面文本搜索和重写代码，覆盖 25 种语言。它能查找形如某种模式的函数、调用、类、导入，做批量替换（codemod），并运行 YAML 规则；改写默认先给预览再应用。
howto.when: 当你的目标是一个语法形态而非字面文本时接管，比如查找形如 X 的每个调用、类或导入，做 codemod，或运行 YAML 规则；若目标是纯字符串、注释、文件名等文本，则改用 rg。

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 执行结构化搜索并列出匹配位置

say.text: 把仓库里的 console.log 全改成 logger.info，先给我预览
say.note: 默认 dry-run，确认后再加参数应用

say.text: 用项目里的 YAML 规则扫一遍，列出违规项
say.note: 运行 sg scan 并汇报结果

howto.what_en: Claude searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. It finds every function, call, class, or import matching a pattern, applies codemods, and runs YAML rules; rewrites default to a dry-run preview.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the target is a syntax pattern, e.g. every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, or a YAML rule. For plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg instead.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter
say_en.note: Runs a structural search and lists matches

say_en.text: Rewrite all console.log calls to logger.info, preview first
say_en.note: Dry-run by default; apply after you confirm

say_en.text: Scan the project with our YAML rules and list violations
say_en.note: Runs sg scan with the project's rules
